observations: Photo 0 shows a car engine bay/engine assembly on a stand or floor, with hoses, wiring, and a turbo-style intake/exhaust piping visible.
No clear readable brand/model plate, engine code, or VIN is visible in the photo.

claims.evidence: No photo evidence of origin (Japan) or any guarantee document/serial number in photo 0.

risks.risk: Exact engine make/model and compatibility are unknown, so the wrong engine could be priced/ordered.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine identification plate/engine code (e.g., on the block) and the full label showing make/model/engine code.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst case for compatibility: treated as unknown/possibly not matching (priced as not guaranteed for fit).

risks.risk: Condition/working status is unknown (could be defective, incomplete, or have internal issues).
risks.proof: A short video of the engine running (cold start if possible) plus a photo of the dipstick/oil condition and any error lights on a connected test.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working / needs overhaul until proven running.

risks.risk: Completeness risk: missing parts (alternator, starter, sensors, turbo components, wiring harness sections) can change value.
risks.proof: A full checklist photo: all accessories laid out (starter, alternator, turbo, injectors, sensors, ECU, harness) or a complete side-by-side of what’s included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown parts included (worst-case deduction).

risks.risk: Mileage/usage history is unknown; “Japan direct” does not confirm low mileage or proper handling.
risks.proof: Photo of odometer/engine hour equivalent if available, or any import/auction sheet showing mileage/grade.

risks.risk: Warranty/guarantee terms are unclear and may not be enforceable in Lagos.
risks.proof: A written warranty document with terms, duration, and what exactly is covered (plus seller contact/address).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the engine code/identification plate on the engine block (readable).
Send a short video of the engine running (show start, idle, and any dashboard/test indicators if applicable).
Confirm what is included: ECU, wiring harness, turbo, alternator, starter, injectors, sensors—send photos of each included item.
Send the warranty document (or message screenshot) showing the exact 2-month terms and coverage.
response.reason: From photo 0, the engine’s exact identity and working condition cannot be confirmed, so a worst-case price would be unreliable without the engine code and proof it runs.
